content.text: The warranty package meets or exceeds the preferred position, and the disclaimer expressly preserves express warranties.

input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 satisfies the preferred position on its material terms. 19.1 warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel and material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications, with no time limit on the services conformance warranty (better than the preferred 90 days). 19.2 gives ninety days after delivery or acceptance for Deliverables and conformance of Hosted Services throughout the subscription term, which for the hosted software equals or exceeds the preferred 12-month software period. 19.3 covers compliance with Applicable Law and absence of malicious code (limited to code intentionally introduced by Vendor — a minor sub-element short of preferred, noted only). 19.4 provides re-performance, repair or replacement and, failing that, termination with a refund of Fees paid, and is expressly non-exclusive for key claim types; Section 6.2 adds a further refund path on rejected Deliverables. 19.5 confirms the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
